name: Late-onset Combined Immunodeficiency due to ICOSL Deficiency
aliases: Late-onset CID caused by ICOSLG mutation

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Proposed Diagnostic Criteria for ICOSL Deficiency-related Late-onset CID

criteria.description: Identification of biallelic pathogenic variants in the ICOSLG gene
Evidence of combined immunodeficiency with decreased T-cell and B-cell function
Presence of recurrent bacterial, viral, or fungal infections starting in adolescence or adulthood
Reduced circulating memory B cells and impaired T-cell proliferation responses
Exclusion of other known causes of combined immunodeficiency

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of biallelic ICOSLG pathogenic variants plus clinical evidence of combined immunodeficiency with recurrent infections
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires integration of genetic, immunological, and clinical data.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Recurrent severe bacterial respiratory tract infections
Hypogammaglobulinemia with markedly reduced memory B cells
searchTerms: low antibody levels with few memory B cells
reduced protective antibodies and B cells
immune deficiency with decreased memory B cells

pathognomonic.symptomName: Impaired T-cell proliferation to mitogens and antigens

searchTerms: chronic yeast infections on skin and mucous

common.symptomName: Recurrent viral infections including herpesvirus reactivations
searchTerms: frequent viral infections including cold sores

common.symptomName: Chronic diarrhea due to gastrointestinal infections

occasional.symptomName: Failure to thrive or weight loss

rare.symptomName: Neurological complications such as peripheral neuropathy

searchTerms: new cancer growths including lymph node tumors

laboratory: Hypogammaglobulinemia with low IgG, IgA, and IgM
Lymphopenia with decreased CD4+ and CD8+ T cells
imaging: Chest CT showing bronchiectasis and recurrent pneumonia sequelae
Lymph node enlargement on ultrasound or CT
other: Poor vaccine response to protein and polysaccharide antigens
Histopathology showing granulomatous inflammation in some cases

distinguishingFeatures: Defect in ICOS gene rather than ICOSLG
Predominantly affects T follicular helper cell function

redFlags: Recurrent severe respiratory infections starting in adolescence or adulthood
references: Schmidt et al., 2023. ICOSL Deficiency Causes Late-Onset Combined Immunodeficiency. Journal of Clinical Immunology.
Orphanet Report on Late-onset Combined Immunodeficiency due to ICOSL Deficiency, ORPHA:695191
Tangye et al., 2022. Combined Immunodeficiencies: Clinical and Genetic Features. Immunology Reviews.
